tools.name: markdown

Returns the page title, final URL after redirects and the markdown text. Paid tool: $0.004 per call in USDC via x402 at GET https://x402-tools.com/

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: Calls an endpoint without paying and reads its x402 payment requirements (v1 body and v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_tools, markdown, screenshot, extract, email_check · Private data: list_tools, markdown, extract, wallet, dns, email_check · Public sink: list_tools, summarize, extract, translate, image, x402_preflight, email_check · Destructive: screenshot, image.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_tools, markdown, screenshot, extract, email_check · Private data: list_tools, markdown, extract, wallet, dns, email_check · Public sink: list_tools, summarize, extract, translate, image, x402_preflight, email_check · Destructive: screenshot, image

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
